slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time the total regular (non-overtime) capacity available across both shifts, or is it the total capacity including any overtime hours?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the interpretation of the 110 hours (regular vs. including overtime) but never asked whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal, nor about its priority relative to the other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 10-hour overtime limit a hard constraint that must never be exceeded?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the nature of the 10-hour overtime rule (whether it is a strict/hard constraint), covering the key meaning of the slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation degraded into repeated incomplete questions and ended without any READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, leaving H1 unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified the overtime rule (H2) but only partially addressed the nature of the 110-hour utilization (H1), and then lost coherence with repeated truncated questions, ending without a final model or readiness signal.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
